mapper.insert: insert into team_user ( team_id, user_id, team_role, withdrawn, joined_at ) values ( #{teamId}, #{userId}, #{teamRole}, 0, NOW() )
mapper.select: select u.*, tu.team_role, tu.joined_at as joinedAt from team_user tu join user u on u.user_id = tu.user_id where tu.team_id = #{teamId} and coalesce(tu.withdrawn, 0) = 0 order by case tu.team_role when 'CAPTAIN' then 1 when 'VICE_CAPTAIN' then 2 else 3 end, tu.joined_at asc, tu.user_id asc
select team_role from team_user where team_id = #{teamId} and user_id = #{userId} and COALESCE(withdrawn, 0) = 0
select team_id from team_user where user_id = #{userId}
